ModMetaData.name: Rework Reforjed
ModMetaData.author: DGZ
ModMetaData.description:
In-memory patching framework for RimWorld 1.6. It is the base other mods depend on: it rewrites the game assembly with Mono.Cecil right before it loads, so mods can add fields, methods, hooks and content to existing classes straight from C#, without touching a single file on disk.
Everything happens in memory: your RimWorld install stays intact, and deleting the mod's folder removes the mod. The API is consumed through plain C# attributes ([ReworkField], [ReworkHook], [ReworkJob], [ReworkRedirect]...). The full manual ships inside the mod as MANUAL.md, and the source lives in Source/.
Built and verified against RimWorld 1.6.4850 (rev646). It does not use Harmony and does not interfere with it.
